en.t: I have long been thinking of you."
This behavior was truly far too abrupt!

units.source_text: 他的声音甚是柔美，但舞姬不认识他，只觉得害怕。

en.t: His voice was very soft and beautiful, but the dancing girl did not know him and only felt afraid.

units.source_text: 正在此时，侍女们急急忙忙地赶来为小姐添妆了。

en.t: Just then, the maidservants hurried over to touch up the young lady's makeup.

units.source_text: 许多人喧哗地走近来，夕雾不便再留，只得遗憾地走开了。

en.t: Many people came noisily approaching, and Yugiri could no longer remain there, so he had no choice but to leave regretfully.
